zh.title: FAA因通訊問題下令全美航班全面停飛
zh.summary: 全美航班於01:15 UTC恢復；先前因通訊問題全面停飛
body: 最初的命令於20:10 UTC以「設備中斷」為由，暫停從芝加哥 O’Hare（ORD） 與 Midway 機場出發的所有航班。運輸部長 Sean Duffy 表示，通訊問題影響全美所有航路交通管制中心。FAA表示，決定是「出於格外謹慎」，並與「暫時性電信中斷」有關。
週五晚間記者會上，Duffy表示，20:36時雷達、通訊、管制中心及 TRACONs 在全美各地出現不穩定。FAA技術人員正在調查這項問題。

en.title: FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop for US flights over a communications issue
en.summary: US flights resumed at 01:15 UTC after a nationwide ground stop over a communications issue.
body: The initial order suspended all flights from Chicago’s O’Hare (ORD) and Midway Airports at 20:10 UTC over an “equipment outage.” Transport Secretary Sean Duffy said the communications issue affected all Air Route Traffic Control Centers. The FAA said the decision was taken “out of an abundance of caution” over a “temporary telecommunications outage.”
At a Friday evening press conference, Duffy said radar, communications, centers and TRACONs across the country experienced instability at 20:36. FAA technicians were investigating the issue.

facts.claim: Merlin announced on November 11, 2026, receiving a $500,000 contract from US Africa Command to demonstrate an autonomous casualty evacuation mission using a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan in Morocco.
facts.sourceQuote: Boston-based Merlin has received a $500,000 contract from US Africa Command (AFRICOM) to demonstrate an autonomous casualty evacuation (CASEVAC) mission using a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan in Morocco, the company announced on November 11, 2026 .

facts.claim: The award covers the initial phase of AFRICOM's Autonomous CASEVAC Industry Technology Challenge, with the demonstration planned for early US government fiscal year 2027.
facts.sourceQuote: The award covers the initial phase of AFRICOM’s Autonomous CASEVAC Industry Technology Challenge, with the demonstration planned for early US government fiscal year 2027, which began on October 1, 2026.

facts.claim: The mission will encompass flight planning, autonomous departure, flight to a casualty collection site, simulated patient loading, and autonomous return flight and landing.
facts.sourceQuote: The mission will run from tasking and flight planning through autonomous departure and flight to an austere casualty collection site. After simulated patient loading, the aircraft will autonomously complete the return flight and landing.

facts.claim: Merlin Pilot is designed to manage flight planning, navigation, contingency response and mission completion without relying on a remote ground station or flight crew.
facts.sourceQuote: Merlin said Merlin Pilot is designed to manage flight planning, navigation, contingency response and mission completion without relying on a remote ground station or flight crew.
